title: What if we always swap children?
hook: This heap reshapes itself without storing a balance rank.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Heap parent/child ordering and priority comparisons.
doesNotKnow: Meld skew heaps with unconditional child swaps and no stored balance ranks.

misconception: Meld requires maintaining an explicit balance field.
objective: Meld skew heaps with unconditional child swaps and no stored balance ranks.

claims.text: A skew heap swaps its children after every recursive meld, without storing a null-path rank. That unconditional structural change distinguishes it from the leftist heap’s rank-based repair.
